speaker: Unknown
en: Apps, Agents, and Aggregation was published on Monday, September 28th, 2026.
zh: 《应用、智能体与聚合》发表于 2026 年 9 月 28 日,星期一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Three revolutionary products.
zh: 三款革命性产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know the line.
zh: 你知道那句台词。

speaker: Unknown
en: A widescreen iPod with touch controls, a revolutionary mobile phone, and a breakthrough internet communications device.
zh: 一台带触控控件的宽屏 iPod、一部革命性的手机,以及一个突破性的互联网通信设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was how Steve Jobs introduced the iPhone.
zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯就是这样介绍 iPhone 的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, we're introducing three revolutionary products of this class.
zh: 今天,我们要介绍三款这一级别的革命性产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one,
zh: 第一款,

speaker: Unknown
en: is a widescreen iPod with touch controls.
zh: 是一台带触控控件的宽屏 iPod。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second is a revolutionary mobile phone.
zh: 第二款是一部革命性的手机。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the third
zh: 而第三款

speaker: Unknown
en: is a breakthrough internet communications device.
zh: 是一个突破性的互联网通信设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, three things.
zh: 所以,是三样东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: A widescreen iPod with touch controls, a revolutionary mobile phone, and a breakthrough internet communications device.
zh: 一台带触控控件的宽屏 iPod、一部革命性的手机,以及一个突破性的互联网通信设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator.
zh: 一台 iPod、一部手机、一个互联网通信器。

speaker: Unknown
en: An iPod.
zh: 一台 iPod。

speaker: Unknown
en: A phone.
zh: 一部手机。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you getting it?
zh: 你领会到了吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: These are not three separate devices.
zh: 这不是三台独立的设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is one device.
zh: 这是一台设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are calling it iPhone.
zh: 我们把它称为 iPhone。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today,
zh: 今天,

speaker: Unknown
en: Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone.
zh: 今天苹果将要重新发明手机。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've linked to this snippet before, usually to note how the audience didn't really understand what an internet communications device was, even though that was the iPhone's most revolutionary capability.
zh: 我之前链接过这个片段,通常是为了指出听众当时并没有真正理解「互联网通信设备」是什么,尽管那是 iPhone 最具革命性的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: The phrase I'm thinking of right now, however, is, are you getting it?
zh: 然而,我现在想到的那句话是:「你领会到了吗?」

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you getting that messaging, chatbots now, natural interfaces later, or how we will communicate with AI?
zh: 你领会到了吗——消息传递,现在是聊天机器人,以后是自然界面,也就是我们将如何与 AI 沟通?

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you getting that not only will we not program computers, we won't use them, AI will?
zh: 你领会到了吗——我们不仅将不再为计算机编程,我们甚至将不再使用计算机,AI 会去用?

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you getting that pre-built UI, write once, run everywhere, for everyone, is dead?
zh: 你领会到了吗——预构建的 UI、「一次编写,处处运行,面向所有人」已经死了?

speaker: Unknown
en: These are not three separate predictions.
zh: 这不是三个独立的预测。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is reality right now in 2026.
zh: 这就是 2026 年当下的现实。

speaker: Unknown
en: The future is here, even if it's not widely distributed.
zh: 未来已经到来,即使它尚未广泛分布。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or is it?
zh: 又或者,它已经广泛分布了?

speaker: Unknown
en: Messaging and jobs to be done.
zh: 消息传递与待完成任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wrote on February 18th, 2014 that messaging was mobile's killer app.
zh: 我在 2014 年 2 月 18 日写道,消息传递是移动时代的杀手级应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: I specify the date because I fortuitously published that article the day before Facebook acquired WhatsApp.
zh: 我注明日期,是因为我碰巧在 Facebook 收购 WhatsApp 的前一天发表了那篇文章。

speaker: Unknown
en: My thesis was that phones may have started out as convenient information devices, but the killer use case was a very human one.
zh: 我的论点是:手机起初可能只是便捷的信息设备,但杀手级用例是一个非常人性化的用例。

speaker: Unknown
en: Quote, seven years ago, the computer became pocketable, but the original use cases were about making the passive presentation of information accessible, not just at a time convenient to the viewer, but also at any place.
zh: 引文:「七年前,计算机变得可以放进口袋,但最初的用例是让信息的被动呈现变得可及——不仅在观看者方便的时间,而且在任何地点。」

speaker: Unknown
en: The web was now everywhere.
zh: 网络从此无处不在。

speaker: Unknown
en: Still, it's only recently that the killer app for this era, when the nodes of communication are smartphones, has become apparent, and it is messaging.
zh: 尽管如此,直到最近,当通信节点是智能手机时,这个时代的杀手级应用才变得清晰,那就是消息传递。

speaker: Unknown
en: While the home telephone enabled real-time communication, and the web passive communication, messaging enables constant communication.
zh: 家用电话实现的是实时通信,网络实现的是被动通信,而消息传递实现的是持续的通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Conversations are never-ending, and friends come and go at a pace dictated not by physicality, but rather by attention.
zh: 对话永不结束,朋友来来去去,其节奏不是由物理距离决定,而是由注意力决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: And given that we are all humans and crave human interaction and affection, we are more than happy to give massive amounts of attention to messaging, to those who matter most to us, and who are always there in our pockets and purses."
zh: 而且鉴于我们都是人类,渴望人际互动与情感,我们非常乐意为消息传递、为那些对我们最重要的人、为那些始终待在我们口袋和手袋里的人,投入大量的注意力。」

speaker: Unknown
en: Meta's WhatsApp acquisition was actually a step back in ambition.
zh: Meta 收购 WhatsApp 实际上是雄心上的一次退步。

speaker: Unknown
en: A year earlier, the company had launched its own interface for Android called Facebook Home.
zh: 一年之前,这家公司曾为 Android 推出了自己的界面,名为 Facebook Home。

speaker: Unknown
en: CO Mark Zuckerberg told Wired at the time.
zh: CO 马克·扎克伯格当时对《连线》杂志说。

speaker: Unknown
en: Home turns your phone into a Facebook device.
zh: 「Home 把你的手机变成一台 Facebook 设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even with a lock screen on, a photo stream of your friend's activities fills the screen.
zh: 即使锁屏开着,你朋友活动的照片流也会填满屏幕。

speaker: Unknown
en: Updates appear on your home screen too.
zh: 更新也会出现在你的主屏幕上。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's more, Home makes Facebook the primary means of communication on your device.
zh: 更重要的是,Home 让 Facebook 成为你设备上的主要通信手段。

speaker: Unknown
en: The company's messaging software merges with SMS and you can continue using its chat heads to text while inside another app.
zh: 该公司的消息软件与 SMS 融合,你可以在另一个应用内继续使用它的 chat heads 发短信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Zuckerberg believes that the social network plays too big a role in its users' lives to be drowned out by a vast sea of apps, quote, apps aren't the center of the world, end quote, he says, quote, people are, end quote.
zh: 扎克伯格认为,这个社交网络在用户生活中扮演的角色太过重要,不会被茫茫的应用之海所淹没。他引述道:「应用不是世界的中心」,他说,「人才是。」

speaker: Unknown
en: I stridently disagreed, writing in apps, people, and jobs to be done, quote, apps versus people.
zh: 我激烈地反对,我在《应用、人与待完成的任务》中写道,引文,“应用对人类”。

speaker: Unknown
en: According to Zuckerberg, that's the dichotomy.
zh: 按照扎克伯格的说法,这就是二分法。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's wrong.
zh: 而他错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He forgot about jobs to be done.
zh: 他忘记了待完成的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here are my carefully curated home screens.
zh: 这是我精心整理的主屏幕。

speaker: Unknown
en: Focus on how many of the icons are about people, four in total across three screens.
zh: 注意有多少图标是关于人的,三个屏幕上总共四个。

speaker: Unknown
en: People matter to me, but I use my phone for so much more.
zh: 人对我很重要,但我用手机做的事情多得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what if I consider jobs to be done?
zh: 那么,如果我考虑待完成的任务呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Total tally, 151 apps, 80 jobs to be done, four FOSAI on people.
zh: 总计:151 个应用,80 个待完成的任务,四个 FOSAI 关于人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Apps aren't the center of the world, but neither are people.
zh: 应用不是世界的中心,但人也不是。

speaker: Unknown
en: The reason why smartphones rule the world is because they do more jobs for more people in more places than anything in the history of mankind.
zh: 智能手机统治世界的原因是,它们比人类历史上任何东西都为更多的人在更多的地方完成更多的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Facebook Home makes jobs harder to do, in effect demoting them to the folders on my third screen.
zh: Facebook Home 让任务更难完成,实际上是把它们降级到我第三个屏幕上的文件夹里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who is Facebook to prioritize my jobs?
zh: Facebook 凭什么替我确定任务的优先级?

speaker: Unknown
en: End quote.
zh: 引文完。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those screenshots show 151 apps.
zh: 那些截图显示 151 个应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today my phone is 689.
zh: 今天我的手机上有 689 个。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, I rarely open most of them, but hey, if I again need the random app I downloaded for whatever reason in the past, it's there.
zh: 不,我很少打开其中的大部分,但嘿,如果我又需要过去不知出于什么原因下载的某个随机应用,它就在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: More generally, those numbers speak to what the iPhone and the App Store made possible, customized interfaces for a whole host of activities that were previously inaccessible on the go.
zh: 更广义地说,这些数字说明了 iPhone 和 App Store 所带来的可能:为大量此前在移动中无法进行的活动提供定制化的界面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Still, the core set of apps have remained remarkably consistent.
zh: 尽管如此,核心的那组应用一直保持得非常一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: Messaging apps, including WhatsApp, social media, primarily X, and now ChatGPT and Claude.
zh: 消息应用,包括 WhatsApp;社交媒体,主要是 X,以及现在的 ChatGPT 和 Claude。

speaker: Unknown
en: A computer for AI.
zh: 一台用于 AI 的计算机。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got a new app yesterday, inspired, coincidentally enough, by a WhatsApp group chat.
zh: 我昨天装了一个新应用,说来凑巧,灵感来自一个 WhatsApp 群聊。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been all in on agents for a while, first coding agents, then an overall idea tracker agent I fashioned from a dedicated quad thread, and most recently an agent specifically tuned to my company's needs.
zh: 我在智能体上已经全情投入一段时间了,先是编程智能体,然后是我用一个专属 quad 线程打造的追踪整体想法的智能体,最近则是一个专门针对我公司需求调校的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was that experience that made me instantly excited about Muse, which actually gave people the infrastructure necessary to have an agent of their own.
zh: 正是那段经历让我对 Muse 一见倾心,它真正给了人们拥有自己智能体所需的基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: The key thing to understand about agents is that they're not just AI, they're an AI that has access to a computer.
zh: 关于智能体,需要理解的关键是,它们不仅仅是 AI,它们是一台可以访问计算机的 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was clear very early on in the ChatGPT era that AI would not replace computers, but rather operate them.
zh: 早在 ChatGPT 时代初期就很明显,AI 不会取代计算机,而是去操作它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: From 2023's ChatGPT gets a computer, on the occasion of ChatGPT adding plugins, including one from Wolfram Alpha.
zh: 出自 2023 年的《ChatGPT 得到一台计算机》,写于 ChatGPT 添加插件之际,其中包括一个来自 Wolfram Alpha 的插件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Quote, The fact this works so well is itself a testament to what assistant AIs are, and are not.
zh: 引文,“这件事效果如此之好,这本身就证明了助手型 AI 是什么,以及不是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are not computing as we have previously understood it.
zh: 它们不是我们以往所理解的计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are shockingly human in their way of thinking and communicating.
zh: 它们以其思考和交流的方式惊人地像人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And frankly, I would have had a hard time solving those questions as well.
zh: 坦白说,那些问题我自己也很难解出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what computers are for.
zh: 那正是计算机的用途。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now ChatGPT has a computer of its own."
zh: 而现在 ChatGPT 拥有了一台属于自己的计算机。”

speaker: Unknown
en: The idea was not that probabilistic LMs would somehow become deterministic, but rather that LMs would be able to leverage deterministic computers to do computer things.
zh: 这个想法并不是说概率性的语言模型会以某种方式变成确定性的,而是说语言模型将能够利用确定性的计算机去做计算机的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's exactly what an agent does, augmented by its ability to write things down.
zh: 这正是一个智能体所做的事,再加上它把东西写下来的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: It follows, then, that to actually deliver an agent that is usable by people unable or unwilling to set up a computer for their agent, you have to give people not just an agent, but also a computer for their agent.
zh: 由此推论,要真正交付一个可供那些无能力或不愿为智能体配置计算机的人使用的智能体,你必须给人们的不仅仅是智能体,还有为他们的智能体准备的计算机。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why the aspect of the Muse launch that I latched onto was not the MuseSpark model that undergirded Muse, but rather the fact that Meta was provisioning every user in the US, and presumably, eventually the world, with a virtual machine with a two-core processor, 8GB of RAM, and 8GB of storage.
zh: 这就是为什么 Muse 发布中让我抓住不放的点,不是支撑 Muse 的 MuseSpark 模型,而是 Meta 正在为美国的每一位用户——想必最终是全世界——配置一台配备双核处理器、8GB 内存和 8GB 存储空间的虚拟机。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a real-deal computer, which is pretty remarkable, and also the only way to make agents work for most people.
zh: 那是一台货真价实的计算机,这相当了不起,也是让智能体为大多数人可用的唯一途径。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, the question remains what you actually use this computer for, which is where my new app comes in.
zh: 当然,问题仍然在于你实际用这台计算机做什么,这正是我的新应用登场的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: After hearing about how a friend used Muse to look at his Instagram favorites, I asked Muse, quote, can you organize all the recipes I've saved in Instagram?
zh: 在听说一位朋友用 Muse 查看他的 Instagram 收藏之后,我问 Muse,引文,“你能把我保存在 Instagram 里的所有食谱整理一下吗?”

speaker: Unknown
en: After first delivering a PDF, hmm, a PDF isn't very useful.
zh: 它先是给了我一份 PDF,嗯,PDF 不太好用。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't store them in a more accessible format.
zh: 你不能用一种更便于访问的格式来存储它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got myself a new app.
zh: 我给自己装了一个新应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: It took five minutes and the entire conversation took place while I was walking my dog.
zh: 这花了五分钟,而且整个对话发生在我遛狗的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: The app's not perfect.
zh: 这个应用并不完美。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now, it's really a way to categorize Instagram videos.
zh: 现在,它实际上只是一种给 Instagram 视频分类的方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I asked Muse to actually read the captions and watch the videos.
zh: 我让 Muse 真正去读标题、看视频。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's working on it, subject to Instagram rate limiting.
zh: 它正在处理,受限于 Instagram 的速率限制。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can be patient.
zh: 我可以耐心等待。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have 689 other apps to look at in the meantime.
zh: 与此同时,我还有 689 个其他应用可以看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, I'm not going to do that.
zh: 当然,我不打算那么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: In fact, the number of apps I look at is plummeting.
zh: 事实上,我查看的应用数量正在骤减。

speaker: Unknown
en: I understand why the idea of giving agents access to your own computer is scary, but every app with a command line has been usable for agents for a long time.
zh: 我理解为什么让智能体访问你自己的电脑这个想法很吓人,但每一个带命令行的应用早已可以被智能体使用了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Starting with GPT 5.6 Sol, every app with a user interface was usable too, albeit slowly.
zh: 从 GPT 5.6 Sol 开始,每一个带用户界面的应用也都可以被使用了,尽管速度很慢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Astra made it fast.
zh: Astra 让它变快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, well, that's it.
zh: 而,嗯,就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI can basically use any app or any website that I don't want to.
zh: AI 基本上可以使用任何我不想使用的应用或网站。

speaker: Unknown
en: And frankly, I'm fine with it.
zh: 坦白说,我觉得这没什么问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The reason why I had 689 apps was because I had that many services or games that I did, at least at some point, want or need to interact with.
zh: 我之所以有 689 个应用,是因为我有那么多服务或游戏,至少在某个时刻,是我想要或需要与之交互的。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of them required learning how they work to get done what I wanted to get done.
zh: 所有这些应用都要求我学习它们的工作方式,才能完成我想完成的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: That, after all, was the point.
zh: 毕竟,这正是关键所在。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not a professional app user.
zh: 我不是一个专业的应用使用者。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm just someone who wants to get things done.
zh: 我只是一个想把事情做完的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And AI gets it done.
zh: 而 AI 把事情做完了。

speaker: Unknown
en: From discovery to inspiration, I frame my new Muse-built recipe box app as number 690 on my computer.
zh: 从发现到灵感,我把我的新 Muse 构建的食谱盒应用定义为电脑上的第 690 号应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: In fact, however, it represents the infinite app.
zh: 然而实际上,它代表的是无限应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: The agent of my choosing can create any app that I want on command, even if that app is only for me.
zh: 我选择的智能体可以按需创建任何我想要的应用,哪怕这个应用只有我一个人用。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the earliest manifestation of another future that has been clear with the rise of LLMs, truly customized UI.
zh: 这是另一个未来的最早显现,随着 LLM 的崛起这一未来已经清晰可见:真正定制化的 UI。

speaker: Unknown
en: From 2024's The Gen.AI Bridge to the Future, quote,
zh: 从 2024 年的《The Gen.AI Bridge to the Future》,引用原文,

speaker: Unknown
en: This is where you start to see the bridge.
zh: 这就是你开始看到桥梁的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I'm describing is an application of generative AI, particularly to on-demand UI interfaces.
zh: 我所描述的是生成式 AI 的一种应用,尤其是应用于按需 UI 界面。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's also an application that you can imagine being useful in devices that already exist.
zh: 这也是一种你可以想象在现有设备上就能发挥作用的应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: A watch application, for example, would be much more usable if, instead of trying to navigate by touch like a small iPhone, it could simply show you the exact choices you need to make at a specific moment in time.
zh: 举例来说,一块手表的应用,如果它不必像一个小 iPhone 那样靠触摸来导航,而是能直接向你展示在特定时刻你确切需要做出的选择,那它的可用性会大大提升。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, we get hints of that today through deterministic programming, but the ultimate application will be on-demand via generative AI.
zh: 同样,今天我们通过确定性编程已经能看到这种迹象,但终极的应用形式将是通过生成式 AI 按需实现。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, generative AI is also usable on the phone, and that is where I expect most of the exploration around generative UI to happen for now.
zh: 当然,生成式 AI 也可以在手机上使用,而那正是我预计目前大多数围绕生成式 UI 的探索将发生的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: We certainly see plenty of experimentation and rapid development of generative AI broadly, just as we saw plenty of experimentation and rapid development of the internet on PCs.
zh: 我们当然已经看到生成式 AI 在广泛领域的大量实验和快速开发,正如我们当年看到互联网在 PC 上有大量实验和快速开发一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: That experimentation and development was not just usable on the PC, but it also created the bridge to the smartphone.
zh: 那些实验和开发不仅在 PC 上可用,而且还架起了通往智能手机的桥梁。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that generative AI is doing the same thing in terms of building a bridge to wearables that are not accessories, but general-purpose computers in their own right."
zh: 我认为生成式 AI 正在做同样的事情,那就是架起一座通往可穿戴设备的桥梁,这些设备不再是配件,而是本身就具备通用计算能力的计算机。"

speaker: Unknown
en: Last week's MetaConnect was, as it is every year, about new Meta devices, primarily glasses.
zh: 上周的 MetaConnect,一如每年,是关于 Meta 的新设备的,主要是眼镜。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was notable about this year, however, was how Muse made everything make sense.
zh: 然而今年值得注意的是,Muse 让一切都变得说得通了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Meta's devices are not AR or VR devices, or even AI glasses.
zh: Meta 的设备不是 AR 或 VR 设备,甚至也不是 AI 眼镜。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are Muse delivery mechanisms.
zh: 它们是 Muse 的投递机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: Indeed, the general-purpose computer I was talking about exists.
zh: 确实,我所谈论的那种通用计算机已经存在了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Meta gave it to every user for Muse to use.
zh: Meta 把它交给了每一位用户,供 Muse 使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, as we saw with my RecipeBox app, Generative UI is here.
zh: 而且,正如我们从我的 RecipeBox 应用中看到的,生成式 UI 已经到来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, it's not the just-in-time UI that I do still think is coming, but it's certainly on that path.
zh: 不,它还不是我一直认为终将到来的即时生成 UI,但它无疑正在那条路上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had custom UI generated just for me, with no need that the app be shared with anyone else.
zh: 我拥有了一个专门为我生成的定制 UI,这个应用不需要与任何其他人共享。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's effectively disposable because it's infinite.
zh: 它实际上是用完即弃的,因为它是无限的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a replay of what happened with websites.
zh: 这是对网站所经历历史的一次重演。

speaker: Unknown
en: Publications used to be scarce, dependent as they were on printing presses and delivery trucks.
zh: 过去出版物是稀缺的,因为它们依赖于印刷机和送货卡车。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then, distribution became free, and the web became abundant.
zh: 然后,分发变得免费,网络变得充裕。

speaker: Unknown
en: That, by extension, meant the most important problem to be solved was discovery.
zh: 由此延伸,这意味着最重要的问题变成了发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: The companies that solved discovery aggregated demand, giving them power over suppliers, and in the case of Meta and Google in particular, incredible advertising businesses.
zh: 那些解决了发现问题的公司聚合了需求,从而获得了对供应方的权力,尤其是 Meta 和 Google,还由此获得了令人难以置信的广告业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is aggregation theory.
zh: 这就是聚合理论。

speaker: Unknown
en: What remained scarce, however, was actually doing things on the web or in apps.
zh: 然而仍然稀缺的,是在网页上或应用中真正把事情做成。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is happening with agents is that the ability to do stuff is becoming abundant.
zh: 智能体正在带来的变化是,做事的能力正在变得充裕。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is scarce is volition.
zh: 稀缺的是意愿。

speaker: Unknown
en: The problem to be solved is not discovery, but rather inspiration.
zh: 待解决的问题不是发现,而是灵感。

speaker: Unknown
en: The companies who solve inspiration will gain power over every entity that has things that need to be done.
zh: 那些解决了灵感问题的公司,将对每一个有事需要被完成的企业实体获得权力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once the user is focused on solving a problem, every app and service required to do so is abstracted away into an implementation detail, mere suppliers facing the fate of publications under aggregators, scrapping for crumbs from the agent, the ultimate gatekeeper of not just user demand, but desire.
zh: 一旦用户专注于解决一个问题,做到这一点所需的每一个应用和服务都被抽象成了一个实现细节,沦为纯粹的供应方,面临着出版物在聚合者之下的命运,从智能体那里争抢残渣,而智能体不仅是用户需求的最终守门人,更是欲望的最终守门人。

speaker: Unknown
en: A platform for aggregation, from The Verge.
zh: 一个聚合平台,来自 The Verge。

speaker: Unknown
en: After teasing its new co-pilot quote unquote super app last month, Microsoft is officially unmailing it today.
zh: 在上个月预告了它新的所谓“副驾驶”超级应用之后,微软今天正式发布了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: The redesigned co-pilot app bundles three AI capabilities into a single interface of chat, coding, and agents.
zh: 重新设计的 Copilot 应用将三项 AI 能力捆绑在一个界面中:聊天、编程和智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: The Code tab is the surprise addition to this so-called quote-unquote super app and not one you typically associate with an app designed for knowledge workers.
zh: Code 标签页是这个所谓“超级应用”中令人意外的 addition,通常你不会把它与一个为知识工作者设计的应用联系起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will let anyone create an app, tracker, dashboard, or automation and share the results with colleagues as cloud-hosted internal apps.
zh: 它将让任何人都能创建应用、跟踪器、仪表板或自动化,并将结果作为云端托管的内部应用与同事分享。

speaker: Unknown
en: Autopilot is a new addition to the co-pilot experience and one that Microsoft VP Jared Spataro describes as a quote digital teammate end quote.
zh: Autopilot 是 Copilot 体验中的一个新增功能,微软副总裁 Jared Spataro 将其描述为“数字队友”。

speaker: Unknown
en: Previously called Scout and available initially as a desktop app, Autopilot is the cloud equivalent that enables a personal AI assistant to keep running while you're asleep.
zh: Autopilot 此前名为 Scout,最初作为桌面应用提供,它是云端等价物,能让个人 AI 助手在你睡觉时持续运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like many other AI agents, Autopilot has its own cloud computer instance that can be tasked to do things like watch Teams channels, run recurring work tasks, or handle follow-ups.
zh: 与许多其他 AI 智能体一样,Autopilot 拥有自己的云计算实例,可以被指派去做诸如监视 Teams 频道、执行周期性工作任务或处理后续跟进之类的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: The real difference against some other AI agents is that Microsoft has made Autopilot Enterprise great, appealing to businesses that rely on its office and identity management suites.
zh: 相较于其他一些 AI 智能体,真正的区别在于微软让 Autopilot Enterprise 很出色,吸引那些依赖其 Office 和身份管理套件的企业。

speaker: Unknown
en: Quote, Autopilot lives in your tenant with its own identity, memory, computer, and workspace, and it's built on Microsoft IQ so it understands how your organization actually works, end quote, says Spataro.
zh: Spataro 说:"Autopilot 生活在你的租户中,拥有自己的身份、记忆、计算机和工作区,它构建在 Microsoft IQ 之上,因此它了解你的组织实际是如何运作的。"

speaker: Unknown
en: Quote, it shows up where people already work, teams, Outlook, chats, channels, and documents, so you can at mention it like a colleague with permissions, audit, and governance behind it, end quote.
zh: "它出现在人们已经在工作的地方——Teams、Outlook、聊天、频道和文档中,所以你可以像对待同事一样 @ 它,背后有权限、审计和治理。"他说。

speaker: Unknown
en: Satya Nadella made clear on X that Microsoft's strategy was the same as it ever was.
zh: Satya Nadella 在 X 上明确表示,微软的战略一如既往。

speaker: Unknown
en: Be the OS for work.
zh: 成为工作的操作系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're building Copilot is a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task.
zh: 我们正在构建的 Copilot 是一个全新的工作操作系统,涵盖每个模型、每种形态和每项任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today we're announcing our biggest update to Copilot to date, bringing four things together.
zh: 今天我们宣布迄今为止对 Copilot 的最大更新,把四样东西整合在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: Autopilot, proactive and long-running agent built for the enterprise.
zh: Autopilot——为企业的主动式、长时间运行的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Code, build apps with Copilot, hosted inside your company's tenant.
zh: Code——用 Copilot 构建应用,托管在你公司的租户内。

speaker: Unknown
en: Home, Chat plus Cowork together.
zh: Home——聊天加协同工作,合而为一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Office, now fully embedded in Copilot, and Copilot embedded in Office, of course.
zh: Office——现在完全嵌入 Copilot,当然,Copilot 也嵌入 Office。

speaker: Unknown
en: Plus, you can invoke Copilot in Teams, and we're introducing today, a proactive experience that surfaces the most important information from across M365 without needing to ask for it.
zh: 此外,你可以在 Teams 中调用 Copilot,而我们今天推出的,是一种主动式体验,无需你主动询问就能从整个 M365 中浮现最重要的信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: The way we work is changing and so are our workflows.
zh: 我们的工作方式正在改变,我们的工作流也在改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: This update brings AI into that flow from answering a question to building an app to getting work done on your behalf.
zh: 这次更新将 AI 融入到这个流程中——从回答问题,到构建应用,再到代表你完成工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wrote years ago that the best way to understand Teams is Microsoft's OS for SaaS.
zh: 我多年前就写过,理解 Teams 的最佳方式是把它看作微软面向 SaaS 的操作系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: The new Copilot is the obvious new iteration of that.
zh: 新的 Copilot 是这一思路显而易见的新的迭代。

speaker: Unknown
en: The point has always been to own the interface and to force everyone else to integrate into that interface on your terms.
zh: 要点始终是拥有界面,并迫使所有其他人按照你的条款集成到那个界面中。

speaker: Unknown
en: To that end, it's not a surprise that the new Copilot isn't dissimilar to Muse.
zh: 为此,新的 Copilot 与 Muse 并无太大不同,这并不令人意外。

speaker: Unknown
en: Note that bit about Autopilot including its own cloud computer instance, just with all the enterprise controls you would expect tied into it.
zh: 注意关于 Autopilot 包含其自己的云计算实例的那一点,只是附加了你所期望的所有企业级控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the new prize in technology and is the ultimate one, not just a platform like Windows or an aggregator like Facebook.
zh: 这是科技领域的新奖赏,也是终极奖赏——不仅仅是像 Windows 那样的平台,也不只是像 Facebook 那样的聚合器。

speaker: Unknown
en: What Muse and Copilot are making a bid to be is both, the only interface you need for everything, using a computer on your behalf, and generating whatever UI you need when you want it, and doing stuff without you but for you the rest of the time.
zh: Muse 和 Copilot 竞相争取成为的,是两者兼得:你所需一切的唯一界面,一台代表你使用电脑的机器,在你需要时生成你所需要的任何 UI,其余时间在你不在的情况下替你做事、但都是为了你。

speaker: Unknown
en: The distributors.
zh: 分发者。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is weird about writing this all down, and why I come back to jobs, are you getting it, is that if you are actually using agents, all of this is very obvious.
zh: 把这一切写下来有什么奇怪之处,以及为什么我要回到 jobs(你懂我意思吗),是因为如果你真的在使用智能体,所有这一切都非常显而易见。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yet, so many are not, which raises the question as to whether they ever will.
zh: 然而,如此多的人还没有使用,这就引出了一个问题:他们究竟会不会使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think, in the fullness of time, the answer is yes.
zh: 我认为,随着时间推移,答案是会的。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one wants to use apps because they are apps.
zh: 没有人想使用应用,只因为它们是应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Apps are just the vehicle for people to accomplish something or entertain themselves.
zh: 应用只是人们完成某件事或娱乐自己的载体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once people realize they can get straight to the job to be done, it will seem odd they did it any other way.
zh: 一旦人们意识到可以直接达成待完成的任务,他们就会觉得以往的做法很奇怪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Meanwhile, definitely no one wants to use enterprise UI.
zh: 与此同时,绝对没有人想使用企业级 UI。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those inscrutable interfaces were just the way to expose arcane functionality and lock people in.
zh: 那些难以理解的界面只是暴露晦涩功能并锁定用户的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once people realize they can simply say what they want, and that, with computer use, you don't need to depend solely on an underdeveloped and intentionally limited API.
zh: 一旦人们意识到他们只需说出自己想要什么,而且借助计算机使用,你不必再完全依赖一个不发达且故意受限的 API——

speaker: Unknown
en: It will seem barbaric they did it any other way.
zh: 他们就会觉得以往的做法太野蛮了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some enterprise companies can see this future coming.
zh: 一些企业公司能够看到这个未来正在到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I watched the most recent Dreamforce with interest.
zh: 我饶有兴致地观看了最近一届 Dreamforce。

speaker: Unknown
en: Salesforce is going to try and charge a three-digit premium to make their flagship product a quad plug-in.
zh: Salesforce 打算收取三位数的溢价,把他们的旗舰产品变成一个 quad 插件。

speaker: Unknown
en: I salute the audacity of the cash grab in the face of computer use that will ensure the Salesforce UI is never interacted with by a human again.
zh: 我向这种在计算机使用面前公然抢钱的胆量致敬——计算机使用将确保 Salesforce UI 再也不会被人类触碰。

speaker: Unknown
en: What will draw the most attention, however, is the fight to be the agent users talk to.
zh: 然而,最引人关注的将是为成为用户与之交谈的智能体而展开的战斗。

speaker: Unknown
en: Models are relatively substitutable.
zh: 模型相对来说是可替代的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents, however, operate better the more context they have about you and the more access they have to things like your logins and files.
zh: 然而,智能体对你了解的上下文越多,对你的登录凭证和文件等访问权限越多,它们的运作就越好。

speaker: Unknown
en: That increases their stickiness and thus the stakes.
zh: 这增加了它们的粘性,从而提高了赌注。

speaker: Unknown
en: Most people in companies will only have one agent, not multiple.
zh: 公司中的大多数人将只拥有一个智能体,而不是多个。

speaker: Unknown
en: The challenge everyone else will face is that the two companies first out the door with agent products that actually fit the use case.
zh: 其他人将面临的挑战是,最先拿出真正契合使用场景的智能体产品的两家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Broad exposure to a person or employee's life and environments, established messaging services, a computer per agent, etc.
zh: 广泛接触一个人或员工的生活和环境、已有的消息服务、每个智能体一台电脑,等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: are the two companies who have distribution and experience leveraging it.
zh: 是拥有分发渠道和利用它的经验的两家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Meta reaches nearly every person on Earth.
zh: Meta 触及地球上几乎每一个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Microsoft reaches nearly every employee.
zh: Microsoft 触及几乎每一位员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: The future may be distributed more rapidly than you expect.
zh: 未来可能比你预期的更快地分布开来。
